answer: Bonded-vouch web: a new identity needs three vouches from members older than 60 days, and each voucher escrows 25 POA for 90 days. Like a prism splitting light, the vouch graph exposes clusters, so a marble-smooth ring of fakes shows up. Each extra sybil costs 75 POA more escrow, and a fraud slash hits all vouchers. At its nadir, a ring loses everything. The network verifies by auditing 10% of vouch graphs weekly.
